category_order: Canonical identifiers sorted lexicographically; union of observed subject/reference sectors; exchange includes accepted NYSE_AMERICAN zero category.
empirical_percentile: count(reference_liquidity <= subject_liquidity)/619; subject included in reference; ties use <=.
fraction_serialization: Exact reduced rational and 60-significant-digit decimal rendering; display rounding only after metric computation.
liquidity: Exact accepted C5 trailing-60-completed-session median daily dollar volume. Decimal strings parsed exactly; no new daily-bar computation.
liquidity_log_range: Natural log(max/min), Decimal precision=80. Input values and exact max/min rational preserved; only transcendental evaluation is approximate.
liquidity_median: Middle order statistic for odd N; exact arithmetic mean of two middle values for even N.
output_encoding: UTF-8; CSV LF line endings; JSON sorted keys, two-space indentation, final LF.
percentile_median: Exact mean of the 21st and 22nd of 42 sorted member percentile fractions.
subject_order: Exact canonical 42-membership order (sorted stable security IDs). No rank-based selection or reselection.
weighting: One equal weight per exact security, subject n=42 and reference n=619; no issuer aggregation.
